findings.description: `decide()` in `watch_prs.py` and `judge()` in `verdict.py` both gained a new refusal branch for `review_complete`, and both decide whether a PR may merge or an issue is done, yet neither is listed in `GATES` in `test_gates_refuse.py`. Neither name matches `NAME_PARTS`, so `test_every_gate_function_is_registered` never sees them and a later change to either gate can lose its refusal test without any failure.
findings.title: Changed gates can drop refusal coverage
